Subject: Data retention exception / next steps (FinLedger pilot)

Hi Alice — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our end: 

- Scope: pilot Redwood hosted inference for FinLedger fraud-detector integration (10k requests/day).
- Data handling ask: FinLedger needs 0-retention for raw request payloads containing PII and a 30-day retention window for aggregated logs/metrics.
- Other asks: SOC 2 evidence, CSV of logging schemas, and a DocuSign for the pilot SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll confirm whether we can do a strict 0-retention mode for raw requests in hosted (short answer: yes with caveats).
2) Legal/Engineering to confirm short-term log retention (30 days) for debug/metrics only and detail controls.
3) Send pilot SOW and SOC 2 packet.

I'll loop in engineering and our compliance lead for concrete language. Attaching an initial proposal that maps our retention controls to your asks.

Attachments: redwood-data-retention-proposal.pdf (summary + config options)

Thanks — Camila

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Data retention exception / next steps (FinLedger pilot)

Camila — quick take from a compliance standpoint:

- 0-retention (request bodies): We can support a 0-retention mode on hosted for request bodies (we avoid persisting the payload server-side beyond in-memory processing and ephemeral KV for inference). We need to flag two caveats in the SOW: 
  1) Debug logs: if FinLedger requires debug logs for a short investigation window we can enable one-time capture under an explicit escalation flow.
  2) Network metadata (source IP) is collected at the infrastructure layer for routing/security; we can either redact it in logs we share, or route through a customer-managed VPC in Dedicated/Private so IP remains within your network.

- 30-day aggregated logs: feasible. We will redact PII fields at ingestion and store only aggregated metrics (counts, latencies, error classes). We'll include sample log schemas and redaction rules in the SOC packet.

I'll draft suggested SOW text: short clause for 0-retention of request payloads, an exception process for debug captures (requires mutual sign-off), and a clause that network metadata may be retained by default but can be excluded from shared logs or kept within a customer VPC.

Adding attachments: SOC 2 evidence stub and sample log schema (see attachment).

 Marissa (Compliance)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@finledger.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention exception / next steps (FinLedger pilot)

Thanks all — engineering notes below: 

- Implementation: we can enable a 0-retention pipeline for this pilot by setting the ingestion path to drop request bodies post-inference and only persist anonymized metrics to our observability store.
- IP handling: by default infra captures source IPs for DDoS/fraud detection; we can mask or hash IPs and ensure masks are one-way (not reversible) in any logs exported to the customer. For full control, Dedicated with VPC keeps IPs inside customer network.
- Debug flow: if FinLedger requests a debug capture, we will persist an encrypted snapshot for up to 7 days, accessible only to named Redwood engineers and FinLedger contacts — requires written approval per the escalation process.

I'll attach a short technical note describing the pipeline change and a sample redaction config.

Attachments: soc2-evidence-stub.zip

 Rafael
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Alice / Legal — thanks for patience. Based on Compliance/Eng feedback: 

Proposed binding items for pilot SOW: 
- 0-retention for request payloads (no persistence post-inference).
- Network metadata: default infra-level collection retained for security; redacted in any logs we export. Option to run pilot in Dedicated/VPC to keep network metadata in-customer.
- Aggregated logs retained for 30 days (counts, latencies, error classes); PII fields redacted at ingestion.
- Debug capture: encrypted snapshot for up to 7 days only with written sign-off from FinLedger (specifies reason + contact).

I've attached the proposed retention language in the SOW section of the proposal and SOC 2 evidence for your review. If this matches your requirements, I'll send a DocuSign for the pilot SOW and we can kick off the onboarding.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/recipient/ABC123-redwood-finledger

Next steps: please confirm acceptance or provide edits by EOD Friday so we can start provisioning.

Thanks — Camila
